title: It’s Shotime: Chase MVP-Caliber Shohei Ohtani Cards—and Bounties
summary: The 2026 MLB Playoffs are a week away—and we've got Shohei Ohtani cards (and bounties) for you to chase.
body_markdown:
One week from today, on Tuesday, September 29th, the first fastball of the 2026 MLB Playoffs will officially be thrown. Luckily, baseball fans on Courtyard don’t need to wait for[The New York Yankees](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Yankees&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[Boston Red Sox](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Red%20Sox&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) ,[Los Angeles Dodgers](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Los%20Angeles%20Dodgers&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bpage%5D=2) ,[Atlanta Braves](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Braves&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BrefinementList%5D%5Bmetadata.Category%5D%5B0%5D=Baseball) , and more to start their postseason runs.


[It’s Shotime!](https://www.mlb.com/news/shohei-ohtani-its-sho-time-ad-spot-debut)


From now through this Friday, September 25th, Courtyard is putting special[Shohei Ohtani](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Shohei%20Ohtani&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) cards into select[Baseball Packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=baseball) daily—and offering up bounties as the icing on the cake.


Whether you bleed Dodger Blue or simply want to chase this generation’s Babe Ruth, we’ve got a rundown of everything you need to swing for the fences.


## **GOATani Isn’t Done:**


The prolific two-way player turned 32 this summer, but he’s showing no signs of slowing down. Ohtani has won the last two NL MVP awards, leading the Dodgers to back-to-back World Series wins in the process—and the four-time MVP winner has got the Dodgers in position to take the title once again: He’s got 30 home runs and a 1.79 ERA on the mound this season as he preps for the playoffs.


## **How to find The Sho on Courtyard:**


Shohei Ohtani’s cards can be found throughout our nine[Baseball Packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=baseball) , as well as in select[Sports Packs](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=sports) , and throughout our marketplace, where you can buy and sell your cards to other collectors.


From his 2018 Exquisite Collection 09-10 Rookie Tribute Auto (BGS 8.5), which has a fair market value of $33,000 found in our[Baseball Legend Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/baseball-legend-pack) , to his 2018 Bowman Chrome Rookie Autographs, which carries a fair market value of $115,000, there are plenty of one-of-a-kind Ohtani long-balls to chase.


Now, pulling an Ohtani card on Courtyard not only comes with the sweet-swinging player’s cardboard, but a bounty, too.


## **Pull a Shohei, Get Courtyard Points:**


Each day brings a new opportunity to pull a unique Ohtani card—and get a bounty just for doing so. Here are the packs, the cards, and the bounties available through Friday:


- **Tuesday, September 22nd:**


- Pack:[Baseball Master Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/baseball-master-pack)
- Chase: 2018 Topps Update #US1 Shohei Ohtani Pitching in Red Jersey (PSA 10)
- Bounty Value: 60k Courtyard Points, worth $200-$300


- **Wednesday September 23rd:**


- Pack:[Baseball Ultra Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/baseball-ultra-pack)
- Chase: 2018 Bowman Chrome Sterling Continuity #BS-SO Shohei Ohtani (PSA 10)
- Bounty Value: 70k Courtyard Points, worth $1,000-$1,500


- **Thursday, September 24th:**


- Pack:[Baseball Platinum Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/baseball-platinum-pack)
- Chase: 2018 Topps Silver Pack 1983 Chrome Promo #51 Shohei Ohtan (PSA 10)
- Bounty Value: 1000k Courtyard Points, worth $2,000-$3,000


- **Friday, September 25th:**


- Pack:[Baseball Diamond Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/baseball-diamond-pack)
- Chase: 2013 BBM 2nd Version #554 Shohei Ohtani (PSA 10)
- Bounty Value: 140k Courtyard Points, worth $4,000-$6,000
